run_grpc_interop_server: run the gRPC interoperability test server on a specified port with optional TLS support
serve_with_tls: start the gRPC test server with TLS credentials using a private key and certificate chain
serve_insecure: start the gRPC test server on an insecure port without TLS encryption
register_test_service: register the TestService servicer to handle gRPC interoperability test requests
parse_server_args: parse command line arguments for the server port and TLS enablement options
